title: Service Fee Receipt Roast Arcade
oneLiner: A playful receipt scanner that turns surprise restaurant service fees into shareable fairness scores and tip math.
targetUser: Diners irritated by surprise service fees, friend groups splitting bills, and food-internet people who screenshot receipts for debate.
keyUX: Upload or mock a receipt, highlight service fees, calculate what the diner actually paid, choose a roast tone, and generate a shareable fairness card with tip guidance.
searchSignals: S10 SFGate Oakland restaurant viral service-fee backlash: https://www.sfgate.com/food/article/bay-area-burdell-reviews-21336111.php
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype called "Service Fee Receipt Roast Arcade" for diners who want to understand and share confusing restaurant service fees. The app should let a user upload or mock a receipt, highlight mandatory fees, calculate true total and tip math, choose a roast tone, and generate a shareable fairness card. Required sections: receipt upload/mock panel, fee highlighter, tip math calculator, fairness score dial, roast tone selector, share card preview, local rule explainer, and restaurant response note. Keep it playful and non-defamatory: the output should explain the math and feelings without encouraging harassment. Design direction: use the `playful-experimental` profile with arcade-like scoring, bold receipt-paper textures, animated-feeling controls, punchy color contrasts, and share-card composition built for screenshots.
